WITH tech_pay AS (
  SELECT e.ref1, eph.rt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ref1 ORDER BY eph.rt_chng_dt DESC, eph.mdfd_dt DESC) AS rn
  FROM emp e
  JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON eph.ref1 = e.ref1
  WHERE e.jb_ttl LIKE 'Production Technician%'
),

  SELECT ref1, rt
  FROM tech_pay
  WHERE rn = 1
),
avg_tech_pay AS (
  SELECT AVG(rt) AS avg_rt
  FROM latest_tech_pay
)
